about: Reprise your role as a supernatural assassin in Dishonored 2.

Praised by IGN as “amazing” and “a superb sequel”, declared a “masterpiece”  by Eurogamer, and hailed “a must-play revenge tale among the best in its class” by Game Informer, Dishonored 2 is the follow up to Arkane Studio's…
Play your way in a world where mysticism and industry collide. Will you choose to play as Empress Emily Kaldwin or the royal protector, Corvo Attano?

Will you make your way through the game unseen, make full use of its brutal combat system, or use a blend of both? How will you combine your character's unique set of powers, weapons and gadgets to eliminate your enemies?
The story responds to your choices, leading to intriguing outcomes, as you play through each of the game's hand-crafted missions.
summary: How far will you go to hunt down your enemies and take back your throne?
